posted.title: From Vague Brief to Viral Ad: Smart Speaker Spec
posted.caption:
Watch AI Transform

Most founders think AI ads look bad because the tech is weak. It’s not. It’s because the brief is boring.

If you just say 'show a speaker,' you get a flat, white-background image that no one stops for. But if you specify 'show sound waves rippling through a cozy night scene with warm lighting,' you get an ad that feels alive.

This spec concept for a smart-home speaker shows exactly how specific creative direction changes the output. We don’t just generate images; we direct the scene.

Stop guessing with vague prompts. DM us "AD" with your product and goal, and we’ll show you the difference.
